prompt.alinti: Your AI coding setup is missing these 5 MCPs 👀
MCPs (Model Context Protocol) help AI tools connect to external tools, documentation, and services, so they can do more than just generate code.
Here are 5 worth exploring for your next build:
Magic UI — Helps AI tools discover and use beautiful, animated UI components.
A collection of animated UI components and templates for modern web projects.
Best for: Beautiful ready-to-use components, animations and templates for React and Next.js projects.
Comment "MCP" and I'll send you the links
